title: RELAY: One Query, Two Roles for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential recommendation must combine semantic preferences with behavioral associations to deliver accurate rankings at low inference cost. Sharing history selection connects preference representation directly to the behavioral evidence used in candidate scoring. We present RELAY, a compact sequential recommender built around one query, two roles: semantic readout and behavioral-memory routing. A single learned query forms a semantic preference representation and reuses its attention to route direct-history and transition evidence into candidate scores. Candidate-conditioned gates calibrate the two memory channels for each candidate. RELAY trains both roles with a single catalog likelihood and produces the final ranking in one forward pass. Full-catalog experiments on six datasets show that RELAY achieves the highest Recall@5 and NDCG@5 among the compared methods on every dataset, improving over the previous best model by 14.22% and 17.

translated_title: RELAY：一次查询，两种角色，用于序列推荐
translated_abstract: 序列推荐必须将语义偏好与行为关联相结合，才能在低推理成本下提供准确的排序结果。共享历史选择将偏好表示直接与候选打分中使用的行为证据联系起来。我们提出了RELAY，一个围绕“一次查询、两种角色”构建的紧凑序列推荐模型：语义读出与行为记忆路由。单个可学习的查询既形成语义偏好表示，又复用其注意力将直接历史证据与转移证据路由到候选打分中。候选条件化的门控机制为每个候选项校准这两个记忆通道。RELAY使用单一目录似然对两种角色进行联合训练，并在一次前向传播中生成最终排序。在六个数据集上的全目录实验表明，RELAY在所有数据集上均取得了对比方法中最高的Recall@5和NDCG@5，相比此前最佳模型分别提升了14.22%和17...%。
tldr: RELAY让单个查询同时承担语义偏好表示与行为记忆路由两种角色，并通过候选条件化门控融合两类证据，在单次前向传播中以低成本实现六个数据集上全面领先的推荐精度。
